$comment: Ground truth for measuring retrieval. Clause numbers and character counts were verified against the live corpus at ingest_version 2 with metadata-only queries. Expectations trace to CLAUSE_REFERENCES in src/dispatch.ts, which records which clause JUSTIFIES a rule -- and a rule citation is not necessarily the passage that ANSWERS a question, which is why every case carries a review status. REVIEW REQUIRED: a dispatcher should move cases from unreviewed to confirmed, or to suspect with a note. Nothing here was authored by reading manual prose; clause numbers, titles and text lengths only.

cases.notes: 8.1.2 was read as 'Criteria for Determining the Usability of Aerodromes' -- navigation aids, runways, curfews, PPR, field conditions, lighting, ARFF/RFFS. That is aerodrome facility adequacy, not weather-versus-alternate planning, so the answering passage is probably a weather sub-clause of 8.1.2. Needs a dispatcher to name the right clause.
